entries.en: Plan mode: introduced new Plan subagent
entries.zh: 计划模式：引入新的 Plan 子智能体

entries.en: Subagents: claude can now choose to resume subagents
entries.zh: Claude 现在可以选择恢复（resume）子代理

entries.en: Subagents: claude can dynamically choose the model used by its subagents
entries.zh: Claude 可以动态选择子代理使用的模型

entries.en: Add branch and tag support for git-based plugins and marketplaces using fragment syntax (e.g., `owner/repo#branch`)
entries.zh: 使用片段语法为基于 git 的插件和市场添加分支和标签支持（例如`owner/repo#branch`）

entries.en: Discovery of custom slash commands, subagents, and output styles no longer respects .gitignore
entries.zh: 自定义斜线命令、子代理和输出样式的发现不再遵循 .gitignore

entries.en: Stop `/terminal-setup` from adding backslash to `Shift + Enter` in VS Code
entries.zh: 阻止 `/terminal-setup` 在 VS Code 中把 `Shift + Enter` 加上反斜杠

entries.en: Fixed a bug where macOS permission prompts would show up upon initial launch when launching from home directory
entries.zh: 修复了从主目录启动时首次启动时会显示 macOS 权限提示的错误
